name: security threat modeling
rules: Identify assets, trust boundaries, threats, controls, abuse paths and residual risk for the changed flow.
Cover authentication, authorization, secrets, diagnostics, dependencies, inputs and runtime boundaries as applicable.
Do not claim a threat is mitigated without an explicit control and verification evidence.
verification: Review the threat model against current contracts, data flows, dependencies and implementation.
Check high-impact threats, control ownership, residual risk and negative-path tests.
